summary: 로아이젠 박성기 대표가 휴머노이드와 서비스로봇을 이해하기 위한 연재를 시작하며, 로봇이 물리적 세계를 다루는 피지컬 AI만으로는 충분하지 않고 사람과 사회적 맥락을 해석하는 소셜 AI가 함께 필요하다는 문제의식을 제기한다. 앞으로의 글은 가능한 행동을 넘어 적절한 행동을 고르는 판단, 데이터로 포착되지 않는 사회적 규범, 모방을 넘어선 규범 학습 같은 주제를 통해 로봇 지능의 평가 기준을 성공률 중심에서 사회적 판단과 실행의 책임까지 넓히려는 흐름을 다룰 예정이다.

title: 마음AI-경복대, 피지컬 AI 교육 협력…직접 로봇 다루는 인재 양성
summary: MaeumAI and Kyungbok University signed an MOU on September 23 to build education, R&D, and workforce-training programs around physical AI. The collaboration is aimed at moving AI education beyond software-only instruction, giving students direct experience with how AI systems operate on robots and interact with the physical world.

title: 美 오픈마인드 “피지컬 AI 준비도 지수, 중국이 세계 1위…한국은 4위”
summary: OpenMind’s 2026 Physical AI Readiness Index ranks China first globally, ahead of Japan and the United States, with South Korea in fourth place. The index scores countries across six weighted areas: energy and power grids, computing and semiconductors, robotics and actuators, materials supply chains, human capital and software, and demand base, framing physical AI readiness as an industrial-infrastructure question rather than just a robotics capability race.

title: 조영훈 한국로봇산업진흥원 원장 취임 인터뷰
summary: Cho Young-hoon took office on April 1 as the seventh president of the Korea Institute for Robot Industry Advancement, the country’s dedicated public agency for robot-industry policy, company support, deployment pilots, workforce training, testing, certification, and regulatory improvement. The interview frames his appointment as coming at a strategic moment, as robots are being recast around “physical AI” systems that perceive, decide, and act in the real world, making robotics central to manufacturing competitiveness and future industrial leadership.

title: “로봇이 스스로 배운다”…스킬드 AI, ‘피지컬 셀프플레이’ 기술 개발
summary: Skild AI introduced Physical Self-Play, a method that lets robots learn new physical skills and strategies by competing against themselves rather than relying on humans to hand-teach each motion. The system builds on Skild’s S1 robot foundation model, which was pretrained from human video, glove data, simulation, and teleoperation data, and is meant to help robots discover task-relevant behaviors on their own as they pursue goals.

title: 금주의 로봇 캘린더(2026. 9. 28 ~ 10. 4)
summary: A weekly Korean robotics calendar lists several events for September 28 to October 4, 2026, including the Korea Institute of Industrial Technology president’s inauguration, Bigwave Robotics’ KOSDAQ listing ceremony at KRX Square, and the closing deadline for the 4th Robot Love Photo Contest. It is mainly useful as a schedule snapshot for tracking institutional and industry activity in Korea’s robotics sector, with Bigwave Robotics’ market debut standing out as the most business-relevant item.

title: 美 넵튠 메디컬, ‘트라이튼 1’ 위장관 내시경 로봇 FDA 승인
summary: Neptune Medical’s Triton 1 System has received FDA clearance for robotic gastrointestinal endoscopy, with an initial focus on colonoscopy across screening, surveillance, diagnostic, and more complex therapeutic procedures. The company says the flexible endoscopic robot is designed to reach the full colon while giving physicians robotic-level precision, stability, and control, which could matter for expanding robot-assisted intervention beyond rigid surgical settings into routine GI workflows.

title: 中 아스트랄, 4족 로봇개 '하이퍼트론-SW01' 공개
summary: China’s ASTRALL has unveiled the Hypertron-SW01, an all-weather quadruped robot dog aimed at firefighting and energy-industry inspection work. It pairs the robot body with in-house AI software and an ecosystem-level solution, offering 40 kg payload capacity, up to 6 hours of battery life, 45-degree slope climbing, and the ability to clear 1 m obstacles, making it suited to constrained or hazardous industrial sites.

title: 美 심비, 10년간 자율 지능형 매장 로봇 3000대 공급계약 돌파
summary: Simbe says it has surpassed contracts for 3,000 autonomous retail inventory robots over the past decade, centered on its shelf-scanning Tally robot. The milestone signals that autonomous shelf digitization has moved beyond pilots into large-scale commercial deployment, with Simbe positioning Tally as one of the largest contracted fleets for in-store shelf intelligence.

title: 印 앤서 로보틱스, FCC로부터 3개 AMR 모델 조건부 승인 받아
summary: ANSCER Robotics’ U.S. sales and service arm has received FCC conditional approval for three autonomous mobile robot platforms, the AR250, AR650, and AR1250, effective September 18. The approval places the robots on the FCC Covered List program’s conditional approval list for robotic devices, clearing an important regulatory step for selling and servicing the Indian AMR maker’s systems in the U.S.

extra.full_text: 인도 자율이동로봇(AMR) 제조업체인 앤서 로보틱스(ANSCER Robotics)의 미국 판매 및 서비스 법인인 앤서 로보틱스(ANSCER Robotics Inc.)가 미국 연방통신위원회(FCC)로부터 자사 AR250, AR650, AR1250 로봇 플랫폼에 대한 조건부 승인(Conditional Approval)을 받았다고 로보틱스247이 최근 보도했다.이 회사는 “이번 승인이 9월 18일자로 효력을 발휘하며, FCC의 커버드 리스트( Covered List) 프로그램에 따른 '로봇 장치 조건부 승인' 목록에 등재됐다”고 발표했다

title: 라이트 오리진, 범용 파운데이션 인공지능 모델 '라이트-O1' 공개
summary: Light Origins launched Light-O1, a general embodied AI foundation model trained at scale on human behavior data extracted from internet videos, with the aim of making one model transferable across many robot platforms. The company, founded in late 2024 by former OpenAI researcher and ChatGPT contributor Roger Jiang, is positioning the model around physical AI infrastructure, pairing large-scale multimodal training with software and hardware R&D after raising pre-Series A funding in August.
